policy: Bundle budget of the production frontend, checked by scripts/check-bundle-budget.mjs (CI static shard). KB = 1,000 bytes. Raising a value = a change of this file in the branch, with a `history` entry and a reason, approved by the BA at the merge. Every value needs a reason; the script refuses the file otherwise.

initialJsGzip.reason: B1 after WP9c. Measured 483,687 B (entry chunk + static import closure, gzip level 9 per file; English dictionary only, every other language is its own chunk) + 36,000 B allowance for the work packages that land before WP9d. Lowered again by WP9d (final: 370,000 B, WP9d must land at 330,000 B or less).

initialJsRaw.reason: B2 after WP9c. Measured 1,589,399 B + 110,000 B allowance for the work packages that land before WP9d. Final: 1,300,000 B (WP9d).

langChunkGzip.reason: B3. One chunk per non-English language (dictionary + date-fns locale, src/i18n/lang-<code>.ts). Measured at WP9c: 40.7 to 49.5 KB gzip (ru the largest); 55 KB leaves room for the texts the later work packages add.

lazyChunkGzip.reason: B4. No lazy chunk of the 1.0.7 release is above 21 KB gzip today; 170 KB leaves room for the PDF.js module of WP5 only through a named exception.

cssGzip.reason: B5. Measured 22,005 B + 4,000 B allowance; one render-blocking stylesheet. Final: 26,000 B.
